name: Immune Dysregulation Disease with Immunodeficiency

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Proposed Diagnostic Criteria for Immune Dysregulation Disease with Immunodeficiency

criteria.description: Presence of chronic or recurrent severe infections indicating immunodeficiency
Evidence of autoimmune cytopenias or autoimmune organ involvement
Abnormal immunophenotyping showing lymphocyte subset imbalance or hypogammaglobulinemia
Identification of pathogenic variants in genes associated with immune regulation
Exclusion of secondary causes of immunodeficiency and autoimmunity

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of at least two major criteria including chronic/recurrent infections and autoimmune manifestations, supported by immunophenotyping abnormalities
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is recommended but not mandatory for diagnosis.

searchTerms: immune system destroying red blood cells
red blood cell breakdown from antibodies

common.symptomName: Chronic diarrhea due to gastrointestinal immune dysregulation

searchTerms: chronic yeast infections on skin and mucous

laboratory: Hypogammaglobulinemia with low IgG, IgA, and/or IgM
Lymphopenia with abnormal T and B cell subsets
Positive direct antiglobulin test in autoimmune hemolytic anemia
imaging: Chest CT showing interstitial lung disease or lymphadenopathy
genetic: Pathogenic variants in genes regulating immune tolerance and lymphocyte function (e.g., CTLA4, LRBA, STAT3)
other: Histopathology of affected tissues showing lymphocytic infiltration and immune-mediated damage

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of lymphadenopathy and splenomegaly with defective Fas-mediated apoptosis
Predominantly hypogammaglobulinemia without prominent autoimmune cytopenias
Later onset and less severe immune dysregulation

redFlags: Severe recurrent infections unresponsive to standard treatment
Failure to thrive or growth retardation in infancy
references: Orange JS, et al. Immune dysregulation syndromes: clinical features and molecular mechanisms. J Allergy Clin Immunol. 2020.
Orphanet: Immune dysregulation disease with immunodeficiency - ORPHA:169361
Tangye SG, et al. Human inborn errors of immunity: 2019 update on the classification from the International Union of Immunological Societies Expert Committee. J Clin Immunol. 2020.
